text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory and I are on our way
home when
we run into Daitaku Helios
and Gold City.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if it isn't Helios and City! What are
you two
doing here?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Probably the same as you. We're
hanging out.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
But running into you guys is giving
destiny! You
know you wanna vibe with
us, so let's do it! ☆

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what?! What exactly are you saying,
Helios?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
She's saying we should all hang out. And
come to think of it... even though we're
roommates, you and I hardly ever spend
time together. This might be a good
opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh! That sounds like fun! Okay, let's
all do
something together!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Then let's chill at this place. ☆ As for
food, hit me
with that Disciplinary
Committee Head
recommendation!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
You want me to pick? Um... This is one
cool
restaurant... so maybe I should
order something
extra cool...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Okay... Do you guys want to try this
"Ultra Giga
Carrot Hamburger Steak
Challenge"?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: You wanna try something like that now?! You never change, Bamboo...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you always go HARD, no matter
what!
You're a real one, Bamboo! ♪

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay... I don't really understand, but
you're on!
Hehe! I just knew this'd be the
best from the
second I saw it!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Let's gooo! Full steam ahead! One, two,
three...
GO!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
This kind of song totally suits your vibe,
Bamboo.
And you're great at singing.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oh man, even your singing goes hard! ☆
Is this
what peak sounds like?! Wahey
heeey!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Aw, thanks! Wahey hey! Let's push it to
the limit
and sing one more! Hehehe!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
So this is the nail salon that I've
heard so much
about! Ohhh, you can even add
words to your
designs!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna go with "guts," "red-hot," and

"friendship"! I want something fiery, and
in
calligraphy!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Your nail game low-key slaps,
Bamboo!
Goated, for real! ☆

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It really makes an impression... You may
even
start a trend, Bamboo.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
You really think so?! You think my
design could
be the next big thing?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...!
Do you really mean it?! Hehehe!
Wow, even
Trainer agrees!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I'll put my cutting-edge
sensibilities
to work coming up with
some cool designs for you
too!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Just leave it to me! We're gonna design
the
bestest, most awesomest nails
anyone's ever seen!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Red stones for red-hot power! Thick
chains for unbreakable bonds! And
then... stones of all
colors to represent
all our rivals!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
And right in the middle, we'll add a big
old cleat-style ring to represent our
dreams! There! I
present to you the
coolest nails ever!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
No, sorry, but let's hold on... There's no
way the
other trainers and instructors are
going to be
okay with this, is there?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With Gold City's help, I manage to avoid
ending
up with nails that look like some
kind of video
game claw weapon!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Woo! Today was high-key amazing!
Banger after
banger, for real! This is why
you're the GOAT,
Bamboo! ☆

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It was hectic,
but it was a lot of fun. I'll
see you
back at the dorm.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! See you back at the academy!
Don't break
curfew, now!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Hehe, maybe. I guess I overdid it a
bit, huh?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: You're not... angry, are you?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Whew! That's a relief! Anyway, sorry
about that!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...I've always kind of been this way. It's
like some
kind of switch flips in my brain
as soon as I get a
compliment.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I get all carried away and I feel like I
want to show
everyone something even
more amazing!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's why, even if starts out as a
compliment, I
usually end up getting
told off... Haha.
Embarrassing, right?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory

Embarrassing, right?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's what I thought! If you're gonna do 
something, you gotta go for broke! All
right! I'm going to put this lesson to
action and write some passionate words
on my nails tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Once she gets an idea, she sticks with it.
That kind of sincerity may be the reason
why she has a
habit of getting out of
hand.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Reliable as ever, Trainer! Then, I'm
counting on
you! Don't hesitate to tell
me if I ever get out of
hand!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite getting a bit out of hand earlier,
Bamboo
Memory is already back to her
normal, honest
self.
